notes: The `dismiss` part declares `activates.requests`, which compiles to one callback prop, `onRemoveRequest`. The `Request` suffix is deliberate: `onRemove` would read as a report that removal happened, and the component cannot know that — it asked, and whoever owns the list decided. See ADR 0007.

Nothing is wired to the callback's return. A request carries no state, so the emitted component has no `removed` to set, nothing to read back, and no uncontrolled fallback: the tag stays on screen until its consumer stops rendering it.

The root is not focusable and carries no role. The only interactive thing here is the `dismiss` button, and its accessible name is the consumer's to supply — the label alone would give every tag on the page the same one.
